key_derivation: `grep -rln USE_DECNUM src/ configure.ac Makefile.am tests/` returns exactly configure.ac, src/builtin.c, src/jq_test.c, src/jv.c, src/jv_parse.c, src/jv_print.c — that is the complete set of files with conditional decnum behaviour, and configure.ac:110-115 is where the macro is defined. `grep -rln 'decNumber.h|decContext.h' src/` returns only src/jv.c, so src/jv.c is the sole bridge to vendor/decNumber (wired in at Makefile.am:9-10,17). The surrounding dtoa machinery is the set returned by `grep -rln 'jvp_dtoa|jvp_strtod|dtoa_context' src/`. The must-still-pass requirement is .github/workflows
